title: Accuracy needs context
summary: Accuracy is the share of group guesses that are correct. It can hide poor performance on a rare group.
introduction: Accuracy is the share of group guesses that are correct. It can hide poor performance on a rare group. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Accuracy is the share of group guesses that are correct. It can hide poor performance on a rare group.

blocks.code:
answers = ["dry", "dry", "dry", "rain"]
predictions = ["dry"] * 4
correct = sum(a == p for a, p in zip(answers, predictions))
print(correct / len(answers))
blocks.title: Accuracy needs context

blocks.text: The output is 0.75. Three of four guesses match, but the rule misses the only rain example.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: A high overall score can hide failure on the group that matters most.
